name: Date Recur Interactive Widget
description: Provides an interactive recurring date widget.
project_description: Provides an interactive field widget for Recurring Dates Field (date_recur). It renders a visual, JavaScript-driven RRULE editor in place of the raw rule textarea: an editor picks a frequency (yearly/monthly/weekly/daily/hourly/minutely/secondly) and interval, by-weekday / by-weekday-position / by-month options, an end condition (never / after N occurrences / on a date), and additional include/exclude dates, while a live human-readable summary and the generated RRULE are shown as they type. The widget plugin (DateRecurInteractiveWidget) extends date_recur's DateRecurBasicWidget, adds data-attributes wiring the start-date, time, timezone and rrule inputs together, and attaches a JS library built on a bundled copy of rrule.js plus jQuery UI. Recurrence values are still stored and validated by the Date Recur field; this module only changes the input experience. Requires Recurring Dates Field 3.x and Drupal 10.3, 11 or 12.
